svg.text: a 1-bit language model computer on one ECP5 FPGA
Machdyne Sergei ML2 · Lattice LFE5U-45F · 512 MB DDR3L · open gateware and firmware · runs Bonsai 1.7B offline
sign bits + a scale per 128 weights
back to back, a row ahead
every weight read once per token (~242 MB); 16 of the chip's 24 DSP blocks
Input X: 16 block-RAM banks, 64 int8 values read per cycle
3,072 values (MX format: blocks of 32 int8, a 4-bit exponent offset each)
64 one-bit lanes per cycle, as two MX blocks of 32
both blocks added: exact int64 row sum
2 output banks (one fills while the CPU reads the other)
8-bit mode (attention over the KV cache): 8 int8 × int8 per cycle
q · K rows for the scores, softmax · Vᵀ for the output
GLU unit: SiLU(gate) × up, straight into the next X
result mirror (engine → CPU) · input staging (CPU → X)
firmware in 96 KB block RAM, integer only:
• the same C code as the PC reference
reads main memory through a 16-byte line
residual adds · MX packing for X
2–8 cycles an element, on the CPU's RAM
1 Mbaud: type a prompt, read the answer
data crosses in the dual-clock RAMs
Per token the engine streams all the weights once, 64 one-bit weights a cycle, while the CPU and the vector unit do the per-head work.
Weights stay 1-bit end to end; activations are int8 with block exponents; every sum is exact.
